contract_name: FrostLink Production Multimodal ML Feature Architecture

target_definition.target_condition: max(T_cargo(tau)) > 4.0 deg C for tau in (t, t+60m]
target_definition.evaluation_population: Non-excursion states at prediction time t (risk_level in [0.0, 1.0])
target_definition.terminal_steps_handling: Set to NaN for final 60m of shipment (no future lookahead beyond trip end)

features.name: T_current
features.calculation: Primary cargo probe reading (or spatial mean across probes at t)
features.hardware_source: Multi-point Digital Temperature Probes (e.g., DS18B20 / RTD Pt100)
features.description: Instantaneous core strawberry cargo temperature.

features.name: T_spatial_range
features.description: Instantaneous spatial thermal stratification across cargo container.

features.name: T_spatial_std
features.description: Instantaneous standard deviation across cargo probes.

features.name: 10m_delta
features.description: 10-minute net cargo temperature drift.

features.name: 10m_slope
features.description: Instantaneous 10-minute temperature rate of change.

features.name: 30m_delta
features.description: 30-minute backward net cargo temperature change.

features.name: 30m_slope
features.description: 30-minute warming/cooling velocity.

features.name: 60m_delta
features.description: Trailing 1-hour net temperature drift.

features.name: 60m_slope
features.description: Trailing 1-hour temperature slope.

features.name: thermal_acceleration
features.description: Second derivative of temperature (acceleration of heating/cooling).

features.name: W60_mean
features.description: Trailing 60-minute mean cargo temperature.

features.name: W60_std
features.description: Trailing 60-minute thermal variance.

features.name: W60_range
features.calculation: max(T(tau)) - min(T(tau)) for tau in [t-50m, t]
features.description: Trailing 60-minute maximum temperature excursion spread.

features.name: time_above_warning_threshold_60m
features.calculation: sum(10.0 for tau where T(tau) > 3.0C in past 60m)
features.description: Cumulative minutes spent above R1 warning threshold in past hour.

features.name: compressor_state
features.hardware_source: Reefer CAN-bus / Relay Monitor (HARDWARE COMPONENT TBD)
features.description: Active operation state of transport refrigeration compressor.

features.name: compressor_duty_cycle_60m
features.calculation: Fraction of time compressor was actively engaged in past 60m
features.description: 60-minute trailing refrigeration duty cycle.

features.name: compressor_current
features.calculation: Current sensor reading on primary compressor motor feed
features.hardware_source: Hall-effect / Shunt Current Sensor (e.g., ACS712 / SCT-013)
features.description: Electrical current draw of refrigeration compressor motor.

features.name: cooling_effectiveness_proxy
features.calculation: abs(dT / dt) / max(0.1, compressor_current) during active chilling
features.hardware_source: Derived from Current Sensor + Cargo Temperature Probes
features.description: Measured cooling yield per ampere of compressor electrical draw.

features.name: door_state
features.hardware_source: Magnetic Reed Switch / Hall Sensor (e.g., MC-38)
features.description: Container cargo door open/close status.

features.name: door_open_duration_current
features.description: Current ongoing door open duration in minutes.

features.name: door_open_count_60m
features.calculation: Number of door open transitions in past 60 minutes
features.description: Frequency of door opening events in the trailing hour.

features.name: time_since_door_close
features.calculation: Elapsed minutes since last transition from 1 -> 0
features.description: Minutes elapsed since the container door was last sealed.

features.name: ambient_temperature
features.hardware_source: External Environmental Sensor (e.g., DHT22 / SHT31 / BME280)
features.description: Outside environmental temperature surrounding vehicle.

features.name: ambient_humidity
features.description: External environmental relative humidity.

features.name: thermal_gradient_ambient_cargo
features.hardware_source: Derived from Ambient Sensor + Cargo Temperature Probes
features.description: Driving thermal gradient between ambient air and cargo interior.

features.name: vehicle_speed
features.calculation: GPS ground speed / OBD-II vehicle telemetry
features.hardware_source: GPS Module / OBD-II Telematics Unit (e.g., NEO-6M / Teltonika)
features.description: Vehicle instantaneous ground speed.

features.name: vehicle_stationary_duration
features.calculation: Elapsed continuous minutes with vehicle_speed < 5.0 km/h
features.description: Continuous duration vehicle has been stationary (traffic/loading).

features.name: route_delay_minutes
features.hardware_source: Navigation / Routing Telematics Service (HARDWARE COMPONENT TBD)
features.description: Estimated transit delay relative to delivery schedule.

features.name: battery_voltage
features.hardware_source: Battery Voltage Sensing Circuit (e.g., Voltage Divider / INA219)
features.description: Refrigeration auxiliary battery / power rail voltage.

features.name: refrigeration_power_watts
features.description: Active instantaneous electrical power consumption of refrigeration unit.

features.name: temp_sensor_valid
features.calculation: 1 if T_current is not null and -30C <= T_current <= 60C, else 0
features.description: Flag indicating valid non-corrupt cargo temperature packet.

features.name: temp_sensor_age_seconds
features.calculation: Time elapsed since last valid temperature transmission
features.description: Age of last received temperature telemetry reading.

features.name: door_sensor_valid
features.calculation: 1 if door_state is not null and reading is within stale limit, else 0
features.description: Flag indicating operational door sensor telemetry.

features.name: compressor_sensor_valid
features.calculation: 1 if compressor current/state telemetry is active and non-null, else 0
features.description: Flag indicating active compressor current and status telemetry.

features.name: gps_valid
features.calculation: 1 if GPS lock is acquired and speed is non-null, else 0
features.description: Flag indicating valid GPS navigation lock.
